summary: Corrects the exploration monitor and extends the exploration into the configuration axis, with fresh execution requested. The leader-completeness monitor was unsound: it ran continuously, so a stale partitioned leader that had not yet seen a higher term was reported as lacking a committed entry, which produced four false positives in local testing of the form leader 1 at term 3 lacks index 4 term 10. Completeness is owed only by a newly elected leader for entries committed before its election, so the monitor now fires only when a state machine transitions into StateLeader. The exploration also now injects membership changes: a selected leader randomly proposes a ConfChangeV2 that adds or removes a learner id or removes or re-adds voter 3, applied through the captured conf-change interface inside a recover that records any apply panic as an event rather than crashing the run, and the summary reports attempted and accepted conf-change counts. Two local runs of the changed harness explored four seed runs with 1 to 6 accepted membership changes each, up to 502 messages delivered and 312 dropped, and reported zero safety violations and no apply panics: a bounded, explicitly scoped negative rather than a finding, with snapshots, restarts and crash-stop faults still excluded and no liveness claim.
